definition_zh: 声呐；声呐设备；用声呐探测；蝙蝠等的回声定位能力
definition_en: a device that uses sound waves to find objects under water, or the method of finding things by reflected sound
core_image: 一只船在水里放出一声短鸣，等回声弹回来，由此量出海面下的地形
scene: 潜水员在水下看不清方向，船长用声呐扫出一片海底的轮廓。Divers could not see in the murky water, so the captain mapped the seabed with sonar.
sceneCN: 这里 sonar 是「声呐设备」（第 1 个义项：发射声波、靠回声探测水下物体的仪器）；句意：潜水员在水下看不清方向，船长用声呐扫出一片海底的轮廓。

pos.zh: 声呐；声呐设备；回声定位

derivatives.zh: 基础词加否定后缀 -less 构成，义为「无声呐设备的」
基础词加 -based 构成，义为「基于声呐的」
基础词加 -man 构成，指军舰上操作声呐的士兵

senses.title: The detecting device
senses.definition: equipment that sends out sound pulses and reads their echoes to locate objects beneath the surface
senses.definitionCN: 发出声脉冲、接收回声以定位水下物体的设备
senses.example: The submarine switched on its sonar and listened for the echo.
senses.exampleCN: 潜艇打开声呐，收听回声。
senses.why: The name was formed from the first letters of sound navigation and ranging, so the device is the original and most familiar sense.
senses.whyCN: 这个名字由「声音、导航、测距」三词的词首字母合成，因此「设备」是它最原始也最常见的意思。

senses.title: The technique
senses.definition: the method of measuring distance and shape by sending sound and timing the returned echo
senses.definitionCN: 靠发出声音并计算回声往返时间，来测量距离与形状的方法
senses.example: Marine geologists rely on sonar to chart the ocean floor.
senses.exampleCN: 海洋地质学家依靠声呐技术绘制海底地图。
senses.why: The same acronym is used for the method itself, because a technique named as navigation and ranging is what the device carries out.
senses.whyCN: 这个缩略词同时指方法本身：设备所执行的正是「导航与测距」这套技术。

senses.title: The animal ability
senses.definition: the natural use of echoes of self-produced sounds by bats, dolphins, and whales to find food and routes
senses.definitionCN: 蝙蝠、海豚和鲸等动物利用自身发出声音的回声来觅食和导航的本领
senses.example: Bats hunt moths in total darkness by sonar rather than by sight.
senses.exampleCN: 蝙蝠在完全的黑暗里靠回声定位而不是靠眼睛捕捉飞蛾。
senses.why: Animals were described with the same word once biologists showed they navigate exactly as the instrument does, by echo rather than by light.
senses.whyCN: 生物学家发现动物完全像这台仪器一样靠回声而不是靠光线导航之后，就用同一个词来描述它们的本领。

senses.title: The hunt by sound
senses.titleCN: 用声呐搜索；声呐式搜寻
senses.definition: a way of searching for or tracking something by picking up its sound, as sonar operators do
senses.definitionCN: 像声呐操作员那样，靠捕捉某物发出的声音来搜索或跟踪它
senses.example: Rescuers sonar the wreck for the faint tapping of survivors.
senses.exampleCN: 救援人员用声呐搜索沉船，寻找幸存者微弱的敲击声。
senses.why: Because sonar means listening through darkness, the word stretched into a general picture of searching by ear rather than by eye.
senses.whyCN: 因为声呐的本领是在黑暗里听，这个词便引申出一种用耳朵而不是眼睛去搜寻的通用画面。

senses.title: The sound trace
senses.definition: an echo or sound signal recorded by sonar, often shown as a bright mark on a screen
senses.definitionCN: 声呐记录到的回声或声信号，通常显示为屏幕上的一处亮点
senses.example: Three sonars appeared on the display, moving fast to the north.
senses.exampleCN: 显示屏上出现了三个声呐回波，正快速向北移动。
senses.why: Operators talk about the marks they see as sonars, so the signal itself borrows the name of the machine that caught it.
senses.whyCN: 操作员把屏幕上看到的痕迹也称作声呐，于是信号本身借用了捕捉它的仪器的名字。

senses.title: The tool for seeing
senses.definition: any method that reveals what is hidden or cannot be seen directly, likened to sonar
senses.definitionCN: 任何用来揭示隐藏或无法直接看见的事物的方法，被比作声呐
senses.example: Big data acts as sonar for a market no analyst can watch alone.
senses.exampleCN: 对于没有哪个分析师能独自盯住的市场，大数据就像一副声呐。
senses.why: Once the machine is an emblem of seeing in the dark, the name freely attaches to tools that bring invisible things into view.
senses.whyCN: 一旦机器成了「在黑暗中看见东西」的象征，这个词就自由地黏附到那些让看不见之物显形的工具上。

intro.en: Sonar is a modern coinage, not an inherited word: it was made from the opening letters of sound, navigation, and ranging, patterned on radar.
intro.cn: sonar 是现代新造词，不是继承下来的词：它按照 radar 的模式，取 sound（声音）、navigation（导航）、ranging（测距）的首字母拼成。

items.en: Sonus means a sound, from the deeper root for sounding.
items.cn: 拉丁语 sonus 意为声音，源于更深的「发声」词根。

items.en: Son passes into French and then into English as a word for noise.
items.cn: son 经由法语进入英语，成为表示声响的词。

items.en: Sound names noise, and navigation and ranging name the work of steering and measuring distance.
items.cn: sound 指声响，navigation 指导航，ranging 指测定距离。

items.en: Secret wartime research on sound detection is remembered only as echo location in later accounts.
items.cn: 战时关于声音探测的秘密研究，后来只以「回声定位」之名留在记载里。

items.en: The acronym is recorded as a public word for the echo method of underwater detection.
items.cn: 这一年左右，该缩略词被登记为公众词汇，指水下的回声探测法。

items.en: The word is borrowed back for the natural echo ability of bats, whales, and dolphins.
items.cn: 这个词被反借到蝙蝠、鲸和海豚天生的回声本领上。

note.en: Sonar belongs to the sound family beside sonic and sonata, and it lives in the field of echo, radar, and ultrasound.
note.cn: sonar 与 sonic、sonata 同属「声音」词族，并且与 echo、radar、ultrasound 共处同一义场。

entries.definition: relating to sound or to the speed of sound
entries.definitionCN: 声音的；声速的，与 sonar 共享表示声音的拉丁词根

entries.definition: a device using radio waves to detect objects
entries.definitionCN: 利用无线电波探测物体的设备；sonar 正是照它的缩略方式造成

entries.definition: having a deep full sound
entries.definitionCN: 声音洪亮低沉的，与 sonar 共享拉丁声音词根，拼写也相近

entries.definition: the natural use of echoes to find the way
entries.definitionCN: 动物利用回声定位的本领，对应 sonar 的第 3 个义项

entries.definition: sound too high for people to hear, used in scanning
entries.definitionCN: 人耳听不见的高频声波，常用来扫描，是声呐使用的媒介

entries.definition: an instrument that measures depth by sound
entries.definitionCN: 靠声音测量水深的仪器，是声呐的兄弟设备

normalIntro.en: Sonar is a bundle of first letters: sound plus navigation plus ranging, a machine named for what it does.
normalIntro.cn: sonar 是一束首字母：声音加导航加测距，机器以它所做的事来命名。

normal.en: Split sonar into son, which means sound, and the -ar ending copied from radar.
normal.cn: 把 sonar 拆成 son（声音）与从 radar 借来的 -ar 结尾。

normal.en: Sound navigation and ranging: the three words behind the acronym explain the whole device.
normal.cn: 声音、导航、测距三个词的首字母藏在其中，解释了整台设备的用途。

normal.en: Active sonar sends a ping out, passive sonar only listens for others.
normal.cn: 主动声呐发出脉冲，被动声呐只接收别人发出的声音。

normal.en: Sonar works where light fails, which is why submarines depend on it.
normal.cn: 声呐在光线不起作用的地方工作，所以潜艇依赖它。

normal.en: Compare radar: radar uses radio waves, sonar uses sound waves.
normal.cn: 对比 radar：radar 用无线电波，sonar 用声波。

abstract.en: Picture a short ping racing down into black water and bouncing back up.
abstract.cn: 想象一声短促的滴鸣冲进漆黑的水里，又弹回水面。

abstract.en: Imagine tracing the seafloor by hand from the timings of returning echoes.
abstract.cn: 想象只靠回声返回的时刻，用手描出海底的轮廓。

abstract.en: Picture a bat shouting in the dark and catching a moth from the reply.
abstract.cn: 想象一只蝙蝠在黑暗里喊了一声，凭回声抓住了飞蛾。

examples.en: The fishing boat uses sonar to avoid rocks beneath the waves.
examples.cn: 渔船用声呐避开浪下的礁石。

examples.en: Old sonars often mistake a school of fish for a submarine.
examples.cn: 旧式声呐常把鱼群误认成潜艇。

examples.en: Whales navigate with sonar in seas too dark for eyes.
examples.cn: 鲸在眼睛派不上用场的深海里靠回声定位导航。

dict_mnemonic.text: 谐音「搜那」——在海上「搜」索「那」艘看不见的船；也可记成 son（儿子）+ ar，儿子在船上一遍遍敲回声。这只是取音联想，与词源无关。

root: 现代缩略词，由 sound（声音）、navigation（导航）与 ranging（测距）的首字母合成，模仿 radar 的造词方式；其中 son- 部分追溯至拉丁语 sonus（声音）。

sensesIntro.en: Sonar starts as the name of the instrument, passes to the measuring method, then to the natural echo ability of animals, and finally to any sound-based search or tool.
sensesIntro.cn: sonar 先指仪器的名称，再指测量方法，然后指动物天生的回声本领，最后泛指任何靠声音的搜寻与工具。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a ship sounding the water and reading the echo that comes back.
core.cn: 核心意象：船向水中发声，读取弹回来的回声。

branches.en: The instrument that sends and reads sound is the concrete core sense.
branches.cn: 发送并读取声音的仪器是具体的核心义项。

branches.en: The measuring method is the technique the instrument performs.
branches.cn: 测量方法是仪器所执行的技术层面。

branches.en: Animals using echoes extend the idea into biology.
branches.cn: 动物利用回声，把这个概念延伸到生物学。

branches.en: The search activity and the echo signal are the operator side of the device.
branches.cn: 搜寻动作与回声信号是仪器在操作员一侧的体现。

branches.en: Both a metal casing and a data tool serve as a way to see what hides in the dark.
branches.cn: 金属外壳与数据工具都充当在黑暗中看清隐藏事物的手段。

intro.en: Sonar is a modern acronym, so it carries no classical affixes; its parts are whole English words brought together by initial letters.
intro.cn: sonar 是现代缩略词，不带古典词缀；它的组成部分是被首字母拼合的完整英语词。

latinIntro.en: The only Latin layer sits in the first part: sonus, a sound, from the verb sonare, to sound.
latinIntro.cn: 唯一与拉丁语相关的层次在第一段：sonus 意为声音，来自动词 sonare（发声）。

items.example: The root son- comes from Latin sonus.
items.exampleCN: 词根 son- 来自拉丁语 sonus。

items.meaningCN: 耳朵听到的振动，即声响
items.example: The first letter of sound gives the start of sonar.
items.exampleCN: sound 的第一个字母为 sonar 提供开头。

items.meaning: the work of finding the way
items.example: Navigation supplies the second letter.
items.exampleCN: navigation 提供第二个字母。

items.example: Ranging supplies the closing letters.
items.exampleCN: ranging 提供收尾的字母。

items.example: The -ar ending echoes radar.
items.exampleCN: -ar 结尾呼应 radar。

items.example: Sonic shares the same sound root.
items.exampleCN: sonic 共享同一个「声音」词根。

items.meaning: a piece played rather than sung
items.meaningCN: 用乐器演奏而不是唱的曲子
items.example: Sonata is a cousin through the same Latin sound word.
items.exampleCN: sonata 经由同一个拉丁「声音」词成为表亲。

items.meaningCN: 反射回来的声音，即回声
items.example: Echo names what sonar listens for.
items.exampleCN: echo 指的就是声呐所听的回声。

items.example: The suffix -less forms sonarless.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -less 构成 sonarless。

latinEntries.meaning: to sound, to make a noise

definition_zh: 奏鸣曲；奏鸣曲式；巴洛克时期的器乐曲
definition_en: a piece of music for one or two instruments in several movements, or the form such a piece follows
core_image: 一架钢琴前坐着演奏者，一个个乐章像一段段谈话依次展开
scene: 音乐厅里灯光暗下，钢琴家深吸一口气，开始弹奏一首奏鸣曲。The hall fell quiet as the pianist settled on the bench and began the slow opening of a sonata.
sceneCN: 这里 sonata 是「奏鸣曲」（第 1 个义项：为一两件乐器写作、由几个乐章组成的器乐曲）；句意：音乐厅里灯光暗下，钢琴家深吸一口气，开始弹奏一首奏鸣曲。

pos.zh: 奏鸣曲；奏鸣曲式；巴洛克器乐曲

collocations.phrase: the first movement of a sonata

derivatives.zh: 词干加指小后缀 -ina 构成，义为「小奏鸣曲」，篇幅短小、技巧较浅
由 sonatina 加 -like 构成，义为「似小奏鸣曲的」
复合词，直接以目标词作限定语，义为「奏鸣曲式」

senses.title: The chamber piece
senses.definition: a longer piece of music for one or two instruments, usually in three or four separate movements
senses.definitionCN: 为一两件乐器写作、通常分为三到四个乐章的较长的器乐曲
senses.example: She performed a Beethoven sonata for cello and piano.
senses.exampleCN: 她演奏了一首贝多芬的大提琴与钢琴奏鸣曲。
senses.why: An old verb meaning to sound gave a noun for a piece that is played rather than sung, and the word kept that concrete sense.
senses.whyCN: 一个意为「发声」的古老动词衍生出「演奏出来的乐曲」这个名词，这个词保留了这一具体意思。

senses.title: The musical form
senses.definition: the large structural pattern of a movement, built on an exposition, a development, and a recapitulation of two main themes
senses.definitionCN: 单个乐章的大型结构模式，由两个主要主题的呈示部、展开部与再现部构成
senses.example: The opening movement is built on sonata form with two contrasting themes.
senses.exampleCN: 开头的乐章建立在奏鸣曲式上，有两个对照鲜明的主题。
senses.why: Because most first movements used this design, theorists named the whole pattern after the piece, so form sense grew out of the work sense.
senses.whyCN: 因为大多数奏鸣曲的第一乐章都用这种设计，理论家便用曲子本身来命名整套结构，于是「曲式」义从「乐曲」义长了出来。

senses.title: The early instrumental piece
senses.definition: in older usage, any piece written for instruments alone, often one of a set of such pieces
senses.definitionCN: 在较早的用法里，泛指任何为乐器单独写作的乐曲，常指成套作品中的一首
senses.example: The collection holds a dozen sonatas for two violins and bass.
senses.exampleCN: 这本曲集收录了十几首为两把小提琴与低音而写的巴洛克器乐曲。
senses.why: Before the modern shape settled, sonata simply marked what was played on instruments, so this older broad sense survives in the names of early collections.
senses.whyCN: 在现代形态定型之前，sonata 只是标记「用乐器演奏的东西」，这一更宽泛的旧义仍留在早期曲集的名称里。

senses.title: The recorded track
senses.definition: a piece or a set of pieces listed under this name in a concert programme or a recording catalogue
senses.definitionCN: 在音乐会的节目单或唱片目录中以此名义列出的曲目或曲集
senses.example: The sonata on the programme was an arrangement for harp.
senses.exampleCN: 节目单上的那首奏鸣曲是为竖琴改编的。
senses.why: A name of a genre also becomes a label on programmes and discs, so sonata can point to a listed entry rather than a fixed form.
senses.whyCN: 体裁名也会变成节目单与唱片上的标签，所以 sonata 可以指向一条目录条目，而不局限于某一种固定曲式。

senses.title: The coherent whole
senses.titleCN: 如奏鸣曲般完整严密的作品
senses.definition: any work of art that unfolds in related parts like the movements of a sonata, forming one deliberate whole
senses.definitionCN: 任何像奏鸣曲各乐章那样由相关部分逐步展开、构成一个精心整体的艺术作品
senses.example: Critics called the trilogy a sonata in three parts, each answering the last.
senses.exampleCN: 评论家把这套三部曲称作一部三乐章的奏鸣曲，每一部都回应前一部。
senses.why: A sonata is a model of parts ordered into a whole, so the word travels to novels, films, and buildings built the same way.
senses.whyCN: 奏鸣曲是「部分被安排成整体」的典范，因此这个词可以移用到以同样方式结构的小说、电影与建筑上。

intro.en: Sonata is Italian, from Latin sonare, to sound, and it entered English as a musical term in the seventeenth century.
intro.cn: sonata 源自意大利语，来自拉丁语 sonare（发声），十七世纪作为音乐术语进入英语。

items.en: Sonare means to sound; its participle sonata means that which has sounded.
items.cn: sonare 意为发声，其分词 sonata 意为「已发声的东西」。

items.en: In early Italian, sonata means a piece that is played rather than sung.
items.cn: 在早期意大利语中，sonata 指用演奏而非演唱的乐曲。

items.en: The borrowing enters English as a musical term for instrumental pieces.
items.cn: 这个借词作为器乐曲的音乐术语进入英语。

items.en: By the eighteenth century the sonata settles into a work of three or four movements for one or two instruments.
items.cn: 到十八世纪，这一体裁已定型为为一两件乐器写作的三到四乐章作品。

items.en: Nineteenth century writers analyse older sonatas and borrow the old broad label for them.
items.cn: 十九世纪的作者分析更早的奏鸣曲，并把那个宽泛的旧标签借用到它们身上。

items.en: Sonata form becomes a standard analytical term beside the playable piece.
items.cn: 现代英语中，sonata form 成为与可演奏曲目并列的标准化分析术语。

note.en: Sonata sits in the Latin sound family with sonic and sonar, and in the musical field with sonatina, cantata, and symphony.
note.cn: sonata 与 sonic、sonar 同属拉丁「声音」词族，在音乐义场里则与 sonatina、cantata、symphony 为邻。

entries.definition: relating to sound
entries.definitionCN: 声音的；声速的，与 sonata 共享拉丁 sonare 词根

entries.definition: a device that finds objects by echo
entries.definitionCN: 靠回声探测物体的设备；只是首字母近似意大利语 sonare，不是同一来源

entries.definition: resonant and deep in sound
entries.definitionCN: 声音洪亮低沉的，与 sonata 同源于表示发声的拉丁词

entries.definition: a short and easier sonata
entries.definitionCN: 短小、技巧较浅的小奏鸣曲，是 sonata 加指小后缀 -ina 构成的形式

entries.definition: a piece that is sung rather than played
entries.definitionCN: 供演唱而不是演奏的康塔塔，正好与 sonata 形成对照

entries.definition: a set of short instrumental movements
entries.definitionCN: 多首短小器乐乐章的套曲，与奏鸣曲同属多乐章体裁

normalIntro.en: Sonata remembers sonare, to sound: it is a piece sounding through the instruments rather than through voices.
normalIntro.cn: sonata 记住了 sonare（发声）：它是靠乐器而不是靠人声唱出来的曲子。

normal.en: The -ata ending is a participle ending, so sonata is a thing that has been sounded.
normal.cn: -ata 是分词词尾，所以 sonata 指的是「已被奏响的东西」。

normal.en: Cantata is a thing sung, sonata a thing played: to sing and to sound split the pair.
normal.cn: cantata 是「被唱的东西」，sonata 是「被奏响的东西」：唱与发声把这对词分开。

normal.en: Sonata form is exposition, development, recapitulation, three steps in one movement.
normal.cn: 奏鸣曲式是呈示、展开、再现三步走完一个乐章。

normal.en: A sonatina is a little sonata, the suffix -ina makes it small.
normal.cn: sonatina 是小奏鸣曲，后缀 -ina 表示「小」。

normal.en: Sonata is a cousin of sonic and sonar, all pointing back to sound.
normal.cn: sonata 与 sonic、sonar 是表亲，都指向「声音」。

abstract.en: Picture a soloist alone on stage, letting one instrument speak for a whole concert.
abstract.cn: 想象一位独奏者独自站在台上，让一件乐器替整场音乐会说话。

abstract.en: See two themes meet in the first movement, argue in the middle, then settle at the close.
abstract.cn: 想象两个主题在第一乐章相遇，中途争论，最后一起收束。

abstract.en: Imagine a set of old violin pieces laid out in a thick leather-bound collection.
abstract.cn: 想象一叠小提琴旧曲谱，摊开在一本厚重的小牛皮封曲集里。

examples.en: His piano sonata took three years to write and one evening to hear.
examples.cn: 他的钢琴奏鸣曲写了三年，听一遍只要一个晚上。

examples.en: Students learn sonata form before they learn to write a symphony.
examples.cn: 学生在学写交响曲之前，先要学奏鸣曲式。

examples.en: The violinist practiced the same sonata every morning for a month.
examples.cn: 小提琴手连续一个月每天早上练习同一首奏鸣曲。

dict_mnemonic.text: 谐音「索拿打」——乐手「索」来乐谱、「拿」起琴弓、「打」拍演奏；也可记作 son（声音）+ ata，一串声音铺开成曲。这只是取音联想，与词源无关。

root: 意大利语 sonata ← 拉丁语 sonare（发声）的分词 sonata（已发声的）；与 cantata（供唱）相对，本义为「供演奏的乐曲」。

sensesIntro.en: Sonata begins as a piece for instruments, narrows into the classical three or four movement work, supplies the name for its structure, and widens again into any art made of answering parts.
sensesIntro.cn: sonata 先指供乐器演奏的乐曲，再收窄为古典的三到四乐章作品，又把自己的名字给了乐章结构，最后再度拓宽，指任何由呼应部分构成的艺术作品。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a player at an instrument, sound moving through it in ordered passages.
core.cn: 核心意象：演奏者坐在乐器前，声音按次序一段段流出。

branches.en: The chamber work for one or two instruments is the centre of the word.
branches.cn: 为一两件乐器写作的室内乐曲是这个词的中心义。

branches.en: The large structural design borrowed the work name for itself.
branches.cn: 大型结构设计借用了作品名来命名自己。

branches.en: The early broad instrumental sense survives in old collections.
branches.cn: 早期宽泛的器乐曲义残留在古老的曲集中。

branches.en: A real piece and a listed programme entry point at the same thing from stage and page.
branches.cn: 真实的乐曲与节目单上的一行条目，从舞台和纸面两处指向同一事物。

branches.en: Both the playable work and a novel in chapters share the shape of parts making one whole.
branches.cn: 可演奏的乐曲与分成章节的小说，都共享「部分构成整体」的形态。

intro.en: Sonata is an Italian loan, built from the Latin verb sonare and the participial ending -ata, the same pattern behind cantata.
intro.cn: sonata 是意大利语借词，由拉丁动词 sonare 加分词词尾 -ata 构成，cantata 用的是同一模式。

latinIntro.en: Latin sonare means to sound, and its feminine participle sonata means that which has been sounded.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 sonare 意为发声，其阴性分词 sonata 意为「已发声的东西」。

items.example: The root son- gives the first part of sonata.
items.exampleCN: 词根 son- 提供 sonata 的开头。

items.meaningCN: 已完成的动作，构成名词
items.example: The ending -ata forms a noun from a verb.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ata 把动词变成名词。

items.example: Sonare is the root verb behind the noun.
items.exampleCN: sonare 是这个词背后的动词词根。

items.example: Sonata came into English through music.
items.exampleCN: sonata 经由音乐进入英语。

items.example: Cantata is the singing twin of sonata.
items.exampleCN: cantata 是与 sonata 相对的「唱」的孪生词。

items.example: The suffix -ina forms sonatina.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ina 构成 sonatina。

items.example: Sonatina marks a smaller, easier work.
items.exampleCN: sonatina 指更短更简单的作品。

items.example: Sonic shares the sound root.
items.exampleCN: sonic 共享「声音」词根。

items.example: Sonorous also reaches back to the sounding root.
items.exampleCN: sonorous 也可追溯到「发声」词根。

items.meaningCN: 为整个乐团写的交响曲
items.example: Symphony grew out of the sonata tradition.
items.exampleCN: symphony 由奏鸣曲传统发展而来。

latinEntries.meaning: to sound, to make a noise

latinEntries.meaningCN: 穿透地发声，是 person 等词的远亲

definition_zh: 声音的；声波的；声速的；音速的
definition_en: relating to sound or to sound waves, or moving at the speed of sound
core_image: 一道声波从喇叭里扩散出来，圈圈向外推开空气
scene: 飞机贴着地面俯冲，机头前方的空气被挤成一层看不见的墙，这就是声障。When the aircraft dived, the air in front of it tightened into an invisible wall until it broke the sonic barrier.
sceneCN: 这里 sonic 是「声速的」（第 2 个义项：与音速或音障有关的）；句意：飞机贴着地面俯冲，机头前方的空气被挤成一层看不见的墙，直到它突破声障。

pos.zh: 声音的；声波的；声速的；音速的

derivatives.zh: 前缀 super-（超过）加 sonic 构成，义为「超音速的」
前缀 sub-（低于）加 sonic 构成，义为「亚音速的」
前缀 trans-（穿过）加 sonic 构成，义为「跨音速的」
sonic 加 -s 构成，义为「声学（尤指声波研究），亦作 sonic 音乐」
sonic 加 -ally 构成，义为「在声音方面」

senses.title: Relating to sound
senses.definition: connected with sound or with sound waves and how they travel
senses.definitionCN: 与声音或声波以及它们如何传播有关的
senses.example: Engineers measure how the walls affect sonic waves indoors.
senses.exampleCN: 工程师测量墙体如何影响室内的声波。
senses.why: The suffix -ic makes an adjective of relating, so the first sense is simply everything that has to do with sound.
senses.whyCN: 词尾 -ic 构成表示「与……有关的」形容词，所以第一个义项就是与声音相关的一切。

senses.title: About the speed of sound
senses.definition: relating to or involving the speed of sound, especially the point where an aircraft crosses it
senses.definitionCN: 与音速有关或涉及音速的，尤指飞行器越过音速的那一刻
senses.example: The old jet could not push through the sonic barrier.
senses.exampleCN: 那架旧喷气机无法突破声障。
senses.why: Once sound is described as something you can catch up with, sonic becomes the adjective for the speed that sound itself sets.
senses.whyCN: 一旦把声音想成一样可以被追上来的东西，sonic 就成了描述「声音本身设定的速度」的形容词。

senses.title: The jump or bang
senses.definition: the loud boom or sharp change heard when an object crosses the speed of sound
senses.definitionCN: 物体越过音速时听到的巨响或骤变
senses.example: A sonic boom rattled the windows of the town below.
senses.exampleCN: 一声音爆震得下方小镇的窗子格格作响。
senses.why: The adjective attached to boom became a fixed phrase, and in loose talk the whole name is cut to sonic when people mean the noise.
senses.whyCN: 形容词与 boom 组合成固定搭配，口语中人们指那声巨响时会把这整个名称简称为 sonic。

senses.title: The brand name
senses.titleCN: 索尼克（游戏角色或连锁店名）
senses.definition: the name of a fast blue character in a video game series, or of various shops and products
senses.definitionCN: 电子游戏系列中那只跑得极快的蓝色刺猬的名字，也指若干连锁店与商品
senses.example: Children queued for the new Sonic game on launch day.
senses.exampleCN: 发售当天孩子们排队等着买新的索尼克游戏。
senses.why: Because the word means sound speed, it sells speed and sound at once, so it was taken as a trade name for games and eateries.
senses.whyCN: 因为这个词同时意味着音速与声音，能一下子卖出「快」与「响亮」，所以被用作游戏和快餐连锁的商标名。

senses.title: The amplified sound
senses.titleCN: 音质方面的；放大声音的
senses.definition: relating to electronically reproduced or amplified sound, as in advertising for headphones and speakers
senses.definitionCN: 与电子重放或放大声音有关的，如耳机与音箱广告中的用法
senses.example: The speakers promise a richer sonic signature than older models.
senses.exampleCN: 这款音箱号称比旧型号有更丰富的音色表现。
senses.why: Sound engineers speak of sonic quality, and from sound reproduction the adjective spreads into how audio equipment is marketed.
senses.whyCN: 声音工程师会谈论「音质」，于是声音重放方面的 sonic 又扩散为音响设备营销的说法。

intro.en: Sonic is a modern English adjective built on the Latin noun sonus, a sound; it is not an inherited word but a learned coinage.
intro.cn: sonic 是现代英语形容词，以拉丁语名词 sonus（声音）为基础构成；它不是继承下来的词，而是书卷式的借构词。

items.en: Sonus names a sound, and sonare means to sound, from a deeper root for ringing.
items.cn: 拉丁语 sonus 指声音，sonare 意为发声，二者源于更深的「鸣响」词根。

items.en: The adjective is coined on the Latin stem with the suffix -ic, first as a technical term.
items.cn: 这个形容词以拉丁词干加 -ic 词尾被新造，最初是技术术语。

items.en: With faster aircraft, the word is used for the speed of sound and the barrier it sets.
items.cn: 随着飞机越来越快，这个词被用于表示音速以及音速构成的障碍。

items.en: Sonic boom names the sharp noise from a craft crossing sound speed.
items.cn: 音爆一词在二十世纪五十年代用于命名越过音速的飞行器发出的爆响。

items.en: With prefixes such as sub and trans, the family expands into a full scale of speeds.
items.cn: 加上 sub、trans 等前缀之后，这个词族扩展成一整条速度刻度。

items.en: The word becomes a trade name and a term for audio quality.
items.cn: 现代英语中，这个词又成了商标名，也用于指称音质。

note.en: Sonic is the adjective of the sound family beside sonar and sonata, and it stands close to acoustic, audio, and the speed words that take it as a prefix.
note.cn: sonic 是「声音」词族里 sonar、sonata 旁的形容词，并与 acoustic、audio 以及那些以它为前缀的速度词相邻。

entries.definition: a device that finds objects by sound echoes
entries.definitionCN: 靠声音回声探测物体的设备，与 sonic 共享「声音」词根

entries.definition: an instrumental piece in several movements
entries.definitionCN: 由多个乐章组成的器乐曲，与 sonic 同出于拉丁 sonare

entries.definition: deep and full in sound
entries.definitionCN: 声音低沉洪亮的，与 sonic 同源，常一起记

entries.definition: relating to sound and how it travels
entries.definitionCN: 与声音及其传播有关的，是最贴切的通用近义词

entries.definition: relating to recorded or broadcast sound
entries.definitionCN: 与录音或广播声音有关的，多用于设备语境

entries.definition: faster than the speed of sound
entries.definitionCN: 超过音速的，以 sonic 为词根加前缀构成

normalIntro.en: Sonic is simple addition: the Latin sound word sonus, a linking letter, and the adjective ending -ic.
normalIntro.cn: sonic 是简单的加法：拉丁「声音」词 sonus，加一个连接字母，再加形容词词尾 -ic。

normal.en: Strip off -ic and you are left with the sound root also seen in sonar and sonata.
normal.cn: 去掉 -ic，剩下的就是 sonar 与 sonata 里也能看到的「声音」词根。

normal.en: Prefixes set the speed: sub is below, trans is across, super is above the sound barrier.
normal.cn: 前缀定速度：sub 在下面，trans 穿过，super 在音障之上。

normal.en: A sonic boom is the bang from breaking the sonic barrier.
normal.cn: 音爆就是冲破音障时那一声巨响。

normal.en: Acoustic leans toward how sound behaves in space, sonic stays closer to the sound itself.
normal.cn: acoustic 偏向声音在空间中的表现，sonic 更贴近声音本身。

normal.en: Think of a wall of air, and a jet pushing at it until it breaks through.
normal.cn: 想象一堵空气的墙，一架喷气机一直推，终于把它撞穿。

abstract.en: Picture rings of sound leaving a speaker and fading through a room.
abstract.cn: 想象一圈圈声音从喇叭里出来，在房间里渐渐淡去。

abstract.en: See a white jet tip touching an invisible line drawn in the sky at sound speed.
abstract.cn: 想象白色的机头尖端，触到天空中一条隐形的声音速度线。

abstract.en: Hear the windows of a quiet street rattle all at once after a distant bang.
abstract.cn: 想象一条安静的街上，远处一声巨响之后窗子同时格格作响。

examples.en: The airport rejects any flight that would cause a sonic boom over the town.
examples.cn: 机场不允许任何会在小镇上空引发音爆的飞行。

examples.en: Concorde carried passengers at sonic speed for almost thirty years.
examples.cn: 协和客机以音速载客飞行了近三十年。

examples.en: Makers advertise richer sonic detail in their newest headphones.
examples.cn: 耳机厂商在新款产品广告中宣传更丰富的音色细节。

dict_mnemonic.text: 谐音「索尼柯」——像「索尼」牌音响一样，一切与声音有关；也可记作 son + ic，son（声音）加形容词尾巴，就是「声音的」。这只是取音联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 sonus（声音）＋形容词词尾 -ic；同源的 sonare 意为发声，构成 sonic、sonar、sonata、sonorous 这一「声音」词族。

sensesIntro.en: Sonic starts as a general adjective for sound, then narrows to the speed sound sets, and from that fixed phrase spreads to shops, products, and audio quality.
sensesIntro.cn: sonic 起初是泛指「声音」的形容词，随后收窄到声音所设定的速度，再从那个固定搭配扩散到商店、商品与音质。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: rings of sound spreading out from a source and pushing the air.
core.cn: 核心意象：一圈圈声音从声源散出，推着空气向前。

branches.en: The general sense covers everything connected with sound.
branches.cn: 泛指义覆盖与声音相关的一切。

branches.en: The speed sense measures sound as a limit to be crossed.
branches.cn: 速度义把声音当成一道可以被越过的界限来测量。

branches.en: The boom is the sound heard when the limit is broken.
branches.cn: 音爆是越过界限时听到的那一声。

branches.en: Both high speed and high sound quality are sold through the same adjective.
branches.cn: 高速度与高音质都借同一个形容词来推销。

branches.en: A general sound word becomes a bright trade name for games and food chains.
branches.cn: 一个泛指声音的词变成了游戏与快餐连锁的亮眼商标。

intro.en: Sonic is a stem plus suffix word, and it in turn feeds a whole set of prefixed speed terms.
intro.cn: sonic 是「词干加词尾」型构词，反过来又催生了一整组带前缀的速度词。

latinIntro.en: Latin sonus is a sound and sonare means to sound, the same base that gives sonar, sonata, and sonorous.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 sonus 意为声音，sonare 意为发声，正是 sonar、sonata、sonorous 的共同底座。

items.example: The root son- gives the first part of sonic.
items.exampleCN: 词根 son- 提供 sonic 的开头。

items.example: The suffix -ic makes an adjective of relating.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ic 构成表示「与……有关的」形容词。

items.example: Super- plus sonic gives supersonic.
items.exampleCN: super- 加 sonic 构成 supersonic。

items.example: Supersonic aircraft cross the barrier quickly.
items.exampleCN: 超音速飞机很快越过声障。

items.example: Sub- plus sonic gives subsonic.
items.exampleCN: sub- 加 sonic 构成 subsonic。

items.example: Subsonic flights make no boom.
items.exampleCN: 亚音速飞行不会产生音爆。

items.example: Trans- plus sonic gives transonic.
items.exampleCN: trans- 加 sonic 构成 transonic。

items.example: Transonic speeds bring strong drag.
items.exampleCN: 跨音速一带阻力很大。

items.example: The suffix -s forms sonics.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -s 构成 sonics。

items.example: The suffix -ally forms sonically.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ally 构成 sonically。

items.example: Acro- gives the name acoustics, a sound cousin.
items.exampleCN: acro- 构成 acoustics，是「声音」词场里的近邻。

definition_zh: 女高音；女高音歌手；高音声部；儿童高音
definition_en: the highest singing voice of women or boys, or a singer who has this voice
core_image: 一束声音从台下直冲剧院的穹顶，最高处只剩一个亮点
scene: 歌剧演到最后一场，全场掌声最热烈的是那位女高音。At the end of the opera, the loudest applause went to the soprano who sang the final aria.
sceneCN: 这里 soprano 是「女高音歌手」（第 2 个义项：具有最高人声的歌唱者）；句意：歌剧演到最后一场，全场掌声最热烈的是那位女高音。

pos.zh: 女高音；女高音歌手；高音声部；儿童高音

derivatives.zh: 由 soprano 加意大利语指小词尾构成，指比高音更高一级的小型乐器
由 soprano 加表示人的后缀 -ist 构成，指女高音歌手

senses.title: The highest human voice
senses.definition: the highest range of the singing voice, usually a woman or boy voice
senses.definitionCN: 歌唱人声中的最高音区，通常指女声或男童声
senses.example: Her voice lies comfortably in the soprano range.
senses.exampleCN: 她的嗓音在女高音音区唱得很舒服。
senses.why: Above in music is sung above the other parts, so Italian sopra took the Latin suffix -anus to name the voice placed on top.
senses.whyCN: 音乐里的「在上」就是比其他声部唱得更高，所以意大利语 sopra 加上拉丁后缀 -anus，造出了「置于最上方」的声部名。

senses.title: A singer with that voice
senses.definition: a woman or boy who sings this highest part
senses.definitionCN: 演唱这个最高声部的女子或男童
senses.example: The soprano received a standing ovation.
senses.exampleCN: 那位女高音歌手赢得了全场起立鼓掌。
senses.why: A voice range easily turns into a job title, so the same noun names the person who owns this high voice.
senses.whyCN: 音区很快就能变成职业称呼，所以同一个名词也指拥有这种高音的人。

senses.title: The highest part in a score
senses.definition: the top part written in a piece of choral or orchestral music
senses.definitionCN: 合唱或管弦乐作品中写在最上面的声部
senses.example: The soprano part enters after four bars.
senses.exampleCN: 高音声部在四个小节后进入。
senses.why: What began as a range and a person becomes a line on the page, marking the top voice in the score.
senses.whyCN: 最初表示音区与歌手的词，进一步变成谱面上的一条线，标出作品中最高的那个声部。

senses.title: The top member of an instrument family
senses.definition: the highest-pitched instrument among a group of similar instruments
senses.definitionCN: 一组同类乐器中音调最高的那种
senses.example: He plays the soprano saxophone in a jazz quartet.
senses.exampleCN: 他在一支爵士四重奏里吹高音萨克斯。
senses.why: Because sopra means above, instrument makers label the highest member of a family with the same word of rank.
senses.whyCN: 因为 sopra 就是「在上」，制琴者便用同一个表示等级的称号，指一家族乐器中最高音的那件。

intro.en: Soprano comes from Italian sopra, above, built on Latin supra and super with a -anus ending for a voice above the others.
intro.cn: soprano 来自意大利语 sopra（在上），建于拉丁语 supra、super 之上，并以 -anus 结尾，指「在他人之上」的嗓音。

items.en: Super and supra mean on top of, above.
items.cn: 拉丁语 super、supra 意为在……之上。

items.en: Sopra keeps the meaning above in everyday Italian.
items.cn: 意大利语 sopra 保留「在上」这一含义。

items.en: Soprano is formed to mark the part placed above the others.
items.cn: 意大利语 soprano 形成，用来标记位置在其余声部之上的声部。

items.en: English borrows soprano as a music term for the highest voice.
items.cn: 英语借入 soprano，作为指最高人声的音乐术语。

items.en: The word spreads to instrument families such as the soprano saxophone.
items.cn: 这个词扩展到乐器家族，如高音萨克斯。

note.en: Soprano names the top voice, and it sits next to the other voice ranks: alto, tenor, and bass.
note.cn: soprano 指最高人声，与其他声部的等级词 alto、tenor、bass 并列。

entries.definition: the highest member of a small instrument family
entries.definitionCN: 小型乐器家族中最高音的那种

entries.definition: a soprano singer
entries.definitionCN: 女高音歌手

entries.definition: the Italian word for above
entries.definitionCN: 意大利语中意为「在上」的词

entries.definition: the voice or part below soprano
entries.definitionCN: 女低音；次于高音的中低声部

entries.definition: the highest normal adult male voice
entries.definitionCN: 男高音

entries.definition: a boy voice, or the high range of notes
entries.definitionCN: 男童高音；高音区

normalIntro.en: Soprano marks the voice placed above the rest, so the word carries the same above idea found in supra and super.
normalIntro.cn: soprano 标记的是被摆在其余声部之上的嗓音，因此带着与 supra、super 相同的「在上」意味。

normal.en: The soprano is the voice above the alto in a choir.
normal.cn: 合唱里女高音是高于女低音的那个声部。

normal.en: Coloratura soprano describes a singer famous for fast, light runs.
normal.cn: 花腔女高音指以快速轻巧走句著称的歌手。

normal.en: A boy soprano sings before his voice breaks.
normal.cn: 男童高音在变声前演唱。

normal.en: The soprano saxophone is the highest horn in its family.
normal.cn: 高音萨克斯是萨克斯家族中音最高的。

normal.en: Remember the family order from soprano down to bass.
normal.cn: 记住从女高音一路往下到男低音的家族顺序。

abstract.en: Imagine a ladder of voices and a light at the very top rung.
abstract.cn: 想象一架嗓音的梯子，最上面一阶亮着光。

abstract.en: Picture one voice slipping out from the crowd and rising alone.
abstract.cn: 想象一个声音从人群中抽身，独自向上攀升。

abstract.en: Think of a sheet of music with the top line marked in red.
abstract.cn: 想象一页乐谱，最上面的那行被红笔标出。

examples.en: The choir is short of sopranos this term.
examples.cn: 这个学期合唱团缺少女高音。

examples.en: An Italian soprano sang the lead role in the opera.
examples.cn: 一位意大利女高音歌唱家出演了这部歌剧的主角。

examples.en: The soprano line was so clear that the harmony sounded bright.
examples.cn: 高音声部非常清晰，和声听起来明亮通透。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「搜普拉诺」——有人找遍全场去找那位嗓音最高的歌手；这只是拆词联想，与词源无关。

root: 意大利语 sopra（在上）+ -ano（表示所属、位置的后缀）→ soprano（置于其余声部之上的嗓音）；sopra 又源自拉丁语 supra、super（在上），核心含义是「最高处」。

sensesIntro.en: Soprano starts as the highest voice, becomes the singer, then the score line, and finally the top member of an instrument family.
sensesIntro.cn: soprano 先指最高的人声音区，再指拥有这种嗓音的歌手，之后指谱面上的高音声部，最后泛指同类乐器中最高音的那件。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a single voice climbing above the rest toward the ceiling of a hall.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个嗓音越过众人，向大厅的天顶攀升。

branches.en: The range itself is the first sense, named for its position above the other parts.
branches.cn: 义项一就是音区本身，因位置在其余声部之上而得名。

branches.en: The range becomes a person, the singer who owns this high voice.
branches.cn: 音区转化为具体的人，即拥有这种高音的歌手。

branches.en: On paper the same word marks the top line of a choir score.
branches.cn: 落在纸面上，同一个词标出合唱谱最上面的那一行。

branches.en: Instrument makers copy the ranking, giving the highest horn the same name.
branches.cn: 制琴者照搬这种等级，让音最高的乐器也用同一个名字。

branches.en: Voice and instrument share one idea: the highest of a group sings above everything else.
branches.cn: 人声与乐器共用一个观念：一组之中最高的那个，总在其他声音之上。

intro.en: Soprano is an Italian borrowing whose parts are sopra, above, and a Latin-style -ano ending, and it has fathered soprano-related words such as sopranino and sopranist.
intro.cn: soprano 是意大利语借词，由 sopra（在上）与拉丁风格的 -ano 词尾构成，并衍生出 sopranino、sopranist 等同族词。

latinIntro.en: The Latin base supra and super mean above, and the ending -anus marks position, so soprano means the part placed above.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语词根 supra、super 意为在上，词尾 -anus 表示位置，所以 soprano 意为「被置于上方」的声部。

items.example: Sopra names the place above the others.
items.exampleCN: sopra 表示在其余声部之上的位置。

items.example: Soprano is the direct source of the English word.
items.exampleCN: soprano 是英语词的直接来源。

items.example: The suffix -ano anchors the voice to its high position.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ano 把这个嗓音固定在其高位上。

items.example: The suffix -ino gives sopranino its small, higher meaning.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ino 让 sopranino 带上小巧、更高的含义。

items.meaning: the highest of a small instrument family
items.meaningCN: 小型同类乐器中最高音的那件
items.example: Sopranino ranks above the soprano instrument.
items.exampleCN: sopranino 比高音款的乐器还要高一级。

items.example: The suffix -ist forms the person noun sopranist.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ist 构成表示人的名词 sopranist。

items.example: Sopranist names the singer rather than the voice.
items.exampleCN: sopranist 指的是歌手，而不是嗓音本身。

items.example: Sopranos end in -s in the plural.
items.exampleCN: sopranos 是加 -s 的复数形式。

items.meaning: of the highest voice or part
items.example: Soprano also works as an adjective before type words.
items.exampleCN: soprano 还可作形容词，放在表示类别的词之前。

definition_zh: 电影配乐；原声带；声轨；伴随而来的声音或氛围
definition_en: the recorded music or full audio that goes with a film, and by extension the sounds that accompany an event
core_image: 带子上的音/波线，与画面并排向前滚动
scene: 观众走出影院，还在哼电影里那首配乐。Leaving the cinema, many people were still humming a tune from the soundtrack.
sceneCN: 这里 soundtrack 是「电影配乐」（第 1 个义项：随影片播放的音乐）；句意：观众走出影院，还在哼电影里那首配乐。

pos.zh: 电影配乐；原声带；声轨；伴随的声音或氛围

collocations.zh: 在配乐中；出现在 soundtrack 里

derivatives.zh: 由动词 soundtrack 加 -ing 构成，指配乐工作或所作的配乐
复合词的前半部分，指听得见的声音

senses.title: The music composed for a film
senses.definition: the music written to accompany a film or television programme
senses.definitionCN: 为电影或电视节目创作、伴随画面播放的音乐
senses.example: The soundtrack made the final scene unforgettable.
senses.exampleCN: 配乐让最后一幕令人难忘。
senses.why: The compound joins sound and track, so first it names the music track laid under the picture.
senses.whyCN: 这个复合词把 sound（声音）与 track（轨道）拼在一起，所以最先指的是铺在画面之下的一条音乐轨。

senses.title: The audio track of a film
senses.definition: the complete audio layer of a film, including dialogue, effects, and music
senses.definitionCN: 影片完整的音频层，包括对白、音效与音乐
senses.example: The DVD lets you listen to the dialogue on a separate track.
senses.exampleCN: 这张 DVD 让你可以把对白放在单独一条轨道上听。
senses.why: Editing films on strips of film gave each audio layer the name of a physical track alongside the image.
senses.whyCN: 早期电影在胶片条上剪辑，每层声音都跟着画面占据一条实体轨道，于是整条声音轨也叫此名。

senses.title: The commercial recording
senses.definition: a record or download released with the music and songs of a film
senses.definitionCN: 随影片发行的收录其音乐与歌曲的唱片或下载内容
senses.example: The soundtrack sold more copies than the film poster.
senses.exampleCN: 原声带卖出的份数比电影海报还多。
senses.why: When film music became a product of its own, the same word shifted from the film strip to the disc in the shop.
senses.whyCN: 当电影音乐本身成为商品，这个词就从胶片条转入商店里的那张唱片。

senses.title: The sounds around an event
senses.definition: the sounds or atmosphere that seem to follow a person or event
senses.definitionCN: 仿佛跟随某人或某事件而来的声音或氛围
senses.example: Laughter was the soundtrack of that summer.
senses.exampleCN: 笑声成了那个夏天的背景声。
senses.why: If a film can be wrapped in music, any experience can be wrapped in sound, so the word spreads to life itself.
senses.whyCN: 既然电影能被音乐包裹，任何经历也就能被声音包裹，于是这个词扩展到生活本身。

intro.en: Soundtrack is a modern compound of English sound, from Latin sonus, and track, from Old French trac, a trail or path.
intro.cn: soundtrack 是现代英语复合词，由 sound（源自拉丁语 sonus）与 track（源自法语 trac，小径、痕迹）拼成。

items.en: Sonus means a sound, a noise.
items.cn: 拉丁语 sonus 意为声音、声响。

items.en: Trac means a track, a line of footprints.
items.cn: 法语 trac 意为足迹、小径。

items.en: Sound and track are both common English words.
items.cn: sound 与 track 在十八世纪都是英语常用词。

items.en: Sound and track are joined for the audio strip of a film.
items.cn: sound 与 track 合成一词，指胶片上的声音条。

items.en: The word spreads to film music and later to released albums.
items.cn: 这个词扩展到电影音乐，后来又指发行的专辑。

items.en: The figurative sense of the sounds around an event appears.
items.cn: 表示事件周围声音与氛围的比喻义出现。

note.en: Soundtrack joins a note word and a path word, and it sits near film terms such as score and dubbing.
note.cn: soundtrack 把一个表示声音的词与一个表示路径的词拼在一起，并与配乐、配音等电影术语相邻。

entries.definition: preventing sound from passing through
entries.definitionCN: 隔音的；由 sound 与 proof 合成，只是同一首部

entries.definition: a person or device that follows a trail
entries.definitionCN: 追踪者；追踪装置，只是同一尾部

entries.definition: to go back along the way you came
entries.definitionCN: 原路返回；同以 track 作后部

entries.definition: the music written for a film
entries.definitionCN: 影视配乐；总谱

entries.definition: replacing the recorded speech of a film
entries.definitionCN: 配音；为影片替换对白

entries.definition: the main tune associated with a film or character
entries.definitionCN: 主题曲；与影片或人物相关的主题旋律

normalIntro.en: Soundtrack is literally a track of sound, a second ribbon running beside the picture.
normalIntro.cn: soundtrack 字面上就是一条「声音的轨道」，是与画面并排前进的第二条带子。

normal.en: Sound plus track: a strip that carries sound.
normal.cn: sound 加 track：一条承载声音的带子。

normal.en: A score is the written music, a soundtrack is the recorded music.
normal.cn: score 是写下来的乐谱，soundtrack 是录下来的音乐。

normal.en: The original soundtrack album collects every song of the film.
normal.cn: 原声带专辑收集影片里的每一首歌。

normal.en: Dubbing changes the voice, a soundtrack adds the music.
normal.cn: 配音改变的是人声，配乐增添的是音乐。

normal.en: A theme belongs to one character, a soundtrack to the whole film.
normal.cn: 主题曲属于某个人物，配乐属于整部影片。

abstract.en: Picture a roll of film with a thin music tape glued behind it.
abstract.cn: 想象一卷胶片，背面粘着一条细细的音乐磁带。

abstract.en: Imagine several parallel ribbons: pictures, voices, effects, and music.
abstract.cn: 想象几条平行的带子：画面、人声、音效与音乐。

abstract.en: Think of a shop shelf where the disc of songs sits beside the film poster.
abstract.cn: 想象货架上一张歌碟摆在电影海报旁边。

examples.en: The director asked a young composer to write the soundtrack.
examples.cn: 导演请一位年轻作曲家来写配乐。

examples.en: We downloaded the original soundtrack after the film ended.
examples.cn: 电影结束后我们下载了原声带。

examples.en: Rain and traffic became the soundtrack of our journey.
examples.cn: 雨声与车流成了我们旅途的声音背景。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「桑得揣克」——桑树下的声音被一路揣进怀里，像一条随身携带的声轨；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 英语 sound（声音，源自拉丁语 sonus）+ track（轨道、路径，源自法语 trac）；复合后指随画面滚动的一条「声音轨道」，再指配乐与原声带。

sensesIntro.en: Soundtrack begins as the audio strip of a film, then names its music, the disc released from it, and finally the sounds that wrap around any event.
sensesIntro.cn: soundtrack 起初指电影的声音条，随后指其中的音乐、由它发行的唱片，最后泛指包裹任何事件的声音。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a ribbon of sound running beside the pictures, frame by frame.
core.cn: 核心意象：一条声音带与画面并排，一格一格向前滚动。

branches.en: The music track under the picture is the everyday sense.
branches.cn: 画面之下的那条音乐轨是日常最常用的义项。

branches.en: The whole audio layer of the film is the technical sense.
branches.cn: 影片完整的音频层是技术层面的义项。

branches.en: A released disc turns the film strip into a product.
branches.cn: 发行的唱片把胶片上的声音条变成商品。

branches.en: Any experience can be given a sound track of its own.
branches.cn: 任何经历都可以被配上属于自己的声音轨道。

branches.en: What you hear in the cinema and what you buy in the shop are the same music in two forms.
branches.cn: 在影院听到的与在商店买到的，是同一段音乐的两种形态。

intro.en: Soundtrack is a compound rather than an affixed word, yet both of its parts are productive: sound builds soundproof and soundscape, track builds backtrack and tracker.
intro.cn: soundtrack 是复合词而非派生词，但两部分都能构词：sound 可组成 soundproof、soundscape，track 可组成 backtrack、tracker。

latinIntro.en: The first part goes back to Latin sonus, a sound, and the second to a French path word trac, so no single Latin affix binds the compound.
latinIntro.cn: 前半部分可追溯到拉丁语 sonus（声音），后半部分来自法语表示路径的 trac，因此整个复合词并不由单一拉丁词缀构成。

items.example: Sound opens the compound.
items.exampleCN: sound 是这个复合词的前半部分。

items.example: Track closes the compound.
items.exampleCN: track 是这个复合词的后半部分。

items.example: Soundtrack names the audio strip of a film.
items.exampleCN: soundtrack 指电影的声音条。

items.example: Soundtracks takes an -s ending.
items.exampleCN: soundtracks 以 -s 结尾。

items.example: Soundtracked marks the past form.
items.exampleCN: soundtracked 标记过去形式。

items.meaning: the act of scoring a film
items.example: The suffix -ing turns the verb into a noun.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ing 把这个动词变成名词。

items.example: Soundproof shows the first part is productive.
items.exampleCN: soundproof 说明前半部分可以自由构词。

items.example: Backtrack shows the second part is productive.
items.exampleCN: backtrack 说明后半部分可以自由构词。

definition_zh: 纪念品；旅游纪念品；回忆中的印记
definition_en: an object kept as a reminder of a place, a person, or an event
core_image: 旅行回家后放在桌上的小陶罐，一看见就想起那片海
scene: 离开古城那天，她在小店买了一只陶罐作纪念。On the last day in the old town, she bought a small clay jar as a souvenir.
sceneCN: 这里 souvenir 是「纪念品」（第 1 个义项：为记住某地而保留的小物件）；句意：离开古城那天，她在小店买了一只陶罐作纪念。

pos.zh: 纪念品；旅行纪念品；回忆的印象

derivatives.zh: 由 souvenir 加 -ed 构成，指带着纪念品回来的，多用于旅行口语
由 souvenir 加 -ism 构成，指把物品当成纪念来收集的倾向

senses.title: An object that brings back a trip
senses.definition: a small object bought or kept in order to remember a place you have visited
senses.definitionCN: 为记住曾经去过的地方而购买或保留的小物件
senses.example: She brought back a wooden spoon as a souvenir.
senses.exampleCN: 她带回一把木勺作纪念品。
senses.why: From sub and venire, the word means coming to mind, and a bought object makes a place come back whenever it is seen.
senses.whyCN: 这个词由 sub（在下）与 venire（来）构成，意为「浮现于心」，而买来的物件让人一看见就重新回到那个地方。

senses.title: A keepsake of a person or event
senses.definition: an item kept in honour of a person, a wedding, or another significant occasion
senses.definitionCN: 为纪念某个人、一场婚礼或其他重要场合而保留的物品
senses.example: The couple kept the dried flowers as a souvenir of their wedding.
senses.exampleCN: 这对夫妇把干花留作婚礼的纪念。
senses.why: The same coming to mind can honour a person as well as a place, so the word also names a keepsake of an event.
senses.whyCN: 同样的「浮上心头」不仅能指向地点，也能指向人物与场合，所以这个词也指纪念某件事情的信物。

intro.en: Souvenir is borrowed from French souvenir, a memory, from the verb souvenir, to remember, built on Latin sub, under or from below, and venire, to come.
intro.cn: souvenir 借自法语 souvenir（记忆），源于动词 souvenir（记得），由拉丁语 sub（在下、从下面）与 venire（来）构成。

items.en: Sub means under, and venire means to come.
items.cn: 拉丁语 sub 意为在下面，venire 意为来。

items.en: Sovenir forms with the sense of coming to mind, remembering.
items.cn: 古法语 sovenir 形成，意为浮上心头、记得。

items.en: Souvenir also names a memory itself, and a gift that holds one.
items.cn: 法语 souvenir 同时指记忆本身，以及承载记忆的赠物。

items.en: English takes souvenir as a token of remembrance.
items.cn: 英语借入 souvenir，指纪念性的物件。

items.en: The spelling souvenier appears early but the modern form settles as souvenir.
items.cn: 早期出现过 souvenier 的拼法，最终定型为 souvenir。

note.en: Souvenir contains the Latin coming verb venire, pointing to forms such as souvenir usage and to the whole family of remembrance words.
note.cn: souvenir 含有拉丁语走动的动词 venire，可与表示纪念的日常词一起记忆。

entries.definition: to suit, from the same venir, to come
entries.definitionCN: 适合、合意；与 souvenir 同含 venire

entries.definition: the arrival of something
entries.definitionCN: 到来；与 venire 同源

entries.definition: a Greek dish of grilled meat in pita
entries.definitionCN: 希腊烤肉卷饼；只是拼写相近，词源不同

entries.definition: a small object kept for its meaning
entries.definitionCN: 纪念物；信物

entries.definition: an object kept as a reminder of someone or something
entries.definitionCN: 纪念物；提醒记忆的东西

entries.definition: a sign or small object standing for something else
entries.definitionCN: 信物；象征

normalIntro.en: Souvenir is the word for remembering, so the object makes the past come up again in the mind.
normalIntro.cn: souvenir 本就是「记得」，所以这样一件物品能让过去重新浮现在心里。

normal.en: A souvenir shop sells postcards and small gifts.
normal.cn: 纪念品商店卖明信片和小礼物。

normal.en: People buy a souvenir to remember a holiday.
normal.cn: 人们买纪念品是为了记住一段假期。

normal.en: A keepsake is kept at home, a souvenir is usually found while travelling.
normal.cn: keepsake 多留在家中，souvenir 多在旅途中买入。

normal.en: Memento and keepsake mean the same as souvenir for a person or day.
normal.cn: 纪念某个人的时候，memento 与 keepsake 都能替代 souvenir。

normal.en: French souvenir means a memory before it means a gift.
normal.cn: 在法语里，souvenir 先指记忆，然后才指礼物。

abstract.en: Picture a small jar on a shelf that brings a whole beach back.
abstract.cn: 想象架子上一个小罐子，让你看见整片海滩。

abstract.en: Imagine holding an old ticket stub and hearing the crowd again.
abstract.cn: 想象捏着一张旧票根，又听到人群的喧闹。

abstract.en: Think of a shelf where every object carries one place on its back.
abstract.cn: 想象一个架子，每件东西背上都写着一个地名。

examples.en: Souvenirs from the island were sold at every corner.
examples.cn: 岛上每个角落都在卖纪念品。

examples.en: He bought a small painting as a souvenir of the trip.
examples.cn: 他买了一幅小画作此行的纪念。

examples.en: Her family sold souvenirs to visitors in summer.
examples.cn: 夏天她的家人向游客卖纪念品。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「苏薇妮儿」——一位叫苏薇妮的小姑娘旅行归来，带回许多小纪念品；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 sub-（在下、从下面）+ venire（来）→ 法语 souvenir（浮上心头，记得；记忆）→ 英语 souvenir（承载记忆的物件），核心含义是「让往事来到心上」。

sensesIntro.en: Souvenir keeps its French meaning of bringing to mind, and comes into English as the object that does the remembering for us.
sensesIntro.cn: souvenir 保留法语「来到心上」的意思，进入英语后专指替我们记住往事的物件。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a small object that makes the mind go back to a time and place.
core.cn: 核心意象：一件小东西，让人看见它就想回到某个时空。

branches.en: A travel object is the most common sense, linked to places seen.
branches.cn: 旅途带回的物件是最常见的义项，与去过的地方相连。

branches.en: The same object serves a person or a day, as a keepsake.
branches.cn: 同样的物件也可以是纪念某个人或某一天的信物。

branches.en: Both senses point to the same idea, an object doing the work of memory.
branches.cn: 两个义项都指向同一想法：由物件替人承担记忆。

branches.en: Shops sell souvenirs before a trip is even over, turning memory into a trade.
branches.cn: 旅程还没结束，商店就在卖纪念品，把记忆变成了生意。

branches.en: Wedding favours and dried flowers carry the same promise to remember.
branches.cn: 婚礼的干花与小礼物也带着同样的记忆承诺。

intro.en: Souvenir is formed from the prefix sub- and the verb venire, and its English family grows through words such as memento, keepsake, and souvenirism.
intro.cn: souvenir 由前缀 sub- 与动词 venire 构成，英语里的同义与派生词包括 memento、keepsake、souvenirism。

latinIntro.en: Sub- means under or from below, and venire means to come, so the pair literally marks something coming up into mind.
latinIntro.cn: sub- 意为在下面、从下面而来，venire 意为来，二者合起来表示「从心底浮上来」。

items.example: The prefix sub- marks the coming from below.
items.exampleCN: 前缀 sub- 标记「从下面而来」。

items.example: Venire is the moving part of the word.
items.exampleCN: venire 是这个词中表示「来」的部分。

items.example: Souvenir is the French source of the English word.
items.exampleCN: souvenir 是英语词的直接来源。

items.example: Souvenirs takes a plural -s in English.
items.exampleCN: souvenirs 在英语中加 -s 构成复数。

items.example: The suffix -ism builds souvenirism.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -ism 构成 souvenirism。

items.example: Souvenirism names the habit of collecting small gifts.
items.exampleCN: souvenirism 指收集小礼物的习惯。

items.meaning: an object kept as a reminder
items.meaningCN: 纪念物；提醒记忆的东西
items.example: Memento is a near synonym of souvenir.
items.exampleCN: memento 是 souvenir 的近义词。

items.meaning: a small object kept for memory
items.example: Keepsake is the native word that souvenir replaced.
items.exampleCN: keepsake 是本土用语，后来与 souvenir 并用。

items.example: Reminder names the purpose of any souvenir.
items.exampleCN: reminder 道出了纪念品的作用。

latinEntries.meaning: to come up to mind, to help

definition_en: a plant of the pea family with pods of edible seeds, or the seed itself, grown for food, oil, and feed
core_image: 豆荚裂开，三颗圆滚滚的黄褐色豆子躺在里面
scene: 农田里，豆荚渐渐鼓胀起来，叶下挂满小小的豆粒。In late summer the farmer walks between the rows and checks how heavy the soybean pods have become.
sceneCN: 这里 soybean 是「大豆、黄豆」（第 1 个义项：结荚的豆类作物及其种子）；句意：夏末时分，农夫走在田间，查看豆荚长得有多饱满了。

pos.zh: 大豆的；大豆制成的（用于复合词）

derivatives.zh: 由 soybean 截短而来，指酱油或大豆制品
英式变体，义同大豆，见于 soya bean、soya sauce
由 soybean 与复合名词连用构成，指大豆胞囊线虫

senses.title: The plant and its seed
senses.definition: an annual legume with pods of small round seeds, or one of those seeds
senses.definitionCN: 一年生豆科植物，豆荚里结着圆形小豆粒；也指这种豆子本身
senses.example: Soybean has become a major export crop in many countries.
senses.exampleCN: 大豆在许多国家已经成为重要的出口作物。
senses.why: The compound answer matches: the ancient word for soy plus the bean, so the name begins as a plant and its pod.
senses.whyCN: 这个复合词就是古代的「豆」加上 bean（豆子），所以名称一开始就同时指向作物与豆荚里的种子。

senses.title: A food and oil source
senses.definition: the seed used as food, made into tofu, soy milk, or pressed for cooking oil
senses.definitionCN: 被用作食物的种子，可制成豆腐、豆浆，或压榨成食用油
senses.example: Many households cook with cheap soybean oil.
senses.exampleCN: 许多家庭用便宜的大豆油做菜。
senses.why: Once people saw how much oil and protein the seed held, the word came to name food and raw material.
senses.whyCN: 当人们发现这种豆子富含油脂和蛋白质后，这个词就转指食物和原料。

senses.title: A farm commodity
senses.definition: the crop traded by the tonne as an agricultural commodity
senses.definitionCN: 以吨计进行贸易的大宗农作物商品
senses.example: Global soybean prices rose after the drought.
senses.exampleCN: 旱灾之后，全球大豆价格上涨。
senses.why: Modern farming treats the plant as a bulk good, so the name refers to a measurable market product.
senses.whyCN: 现代农业把这种植物当作大宗商品，所以名称也指可计量的市场产品。

senses.title: Feed for animals
senses.definition: the meal left after oil is pressed, used to feed farm animals
senses.definitionCN: 榨油后剩下的豆粕，用来喂养家畜
senses.example: Farmers mix soybean meal into pig feed.
senses.exampleCN: 农民在猪饲料里掺入豆粕。
senses.why: High protein made the pressed remains valuable, so the word spread to animal feed.
senses.whyCN: 高蛋白让榨油后的残渣也很有价值，于是这个词延伸到了动物饲料。

senses.title: Genetic research subject
senses.definition: a plant often modified in laboratories to resist pests or herbicides
senses.definitionCN: 常在实验室中被改造、以抗虫或抗除草剂的植物
senses.example: Most fields here grow modified soybean varieties.
senses.exampleCN: 这里的多数农田种的是改良大豆品种。
senses.why: The seed became a favourite object of genetic engineering, adding a scientific sense to the farm word.
senses.whyCN: 这种豆子成为基因工程最常用的对象，使这个农业词又多了一层科学含义。

senses.title: A symbol of trade rivalry
senses.definition: a crop named in news reports about tariffs and import bans
senses.definitionCN: 在关税与进口禁令的报道中被点名的农作物
senses.example: Talks over soybean imports dragged on for months.
senses.exampleCN: 关于大豆进口的谈判拖了几个月。
senses.why: Because trade in the bean is huge, its name now labels disputes over supply and tariffs.
senses.whyCN: 由于这种豆子的贸易量极大，它的名字如今常用来指代供应与关税方面的争端。

senses.title: Soy as a general label
senses.definition: a shortened general label for soy products in shop and menu names
senses.definitionCN: 在店名与菜单中用作大豆类制品的简称
senses.example: The carton simply says soybean drink.
senses.exampleCN: 盒子上只写着「大豆饮料」。
senses.why: Shortened forms like soy and soya let shoppers name the whole family of products at a glance.
senses.whyCN: soy、soya 这类简称让顾客一眼就能概括整类产品。

intro.en: Soybean joins an old word for soy, which probably came from Japanese, with English bean.
intro.cn: soybean 由一个古老的表示「酱油、大豆」的词（一般认为来自日语）与英语 bean 组合而成。

items.en: The plant has long been cultivated in China, whose name for it reached Europe through trade.
items.cn: 这种作物长期在中国栽培，其名称经由贸易传入欧洲。

items.en: Shoyu, the Japanese word for soy sauce, is the usual source of soy.
items.cn: 一般认为 soy 来自日语 shoyu（酱油）。

items.en: Soja appears in Dutch writings as a name for the sauce and the bean.
items.cn: soja 约在十七世纪末出现在荷兰文献中，指酱汁和豆子。

items.en: Soja is used in German works on botany and trade.
items.cn: 德语文献在植物学与贸易记述中使用 soja。

items.en: English takes soy by 1679 and soy bean in the late eighteenth century.
items.cn: 英语在十七世纪末已用 soy，十八世纪末出现 soy bean。

items.en: Soybean settles into the spellings S-O-Y-B-E-A-N and S-O-Y-B-E-A-N-S.
items.cn: 美式英语中逐渐固定为如今 soybean 与 soybeans 的拼写。

note.en: Soybean sits in the family of bean words, next to soy, soya, and neighbouring crops.
note.cn: soybean 属于 bean 这一词族，与 soy、soya 以及邻近农作物的名称相关。

entries.definition: the shortened name for soy sauce or soy products
entries.definitionCN: soybean 的截短形式，指酱油或大豆制品

entries.definition: a British variant of the plant name
entries.definitionCN: 英式变体，与 soybean 同指这种植物

entries.definition: a salty dark sauce made from fermented soybeans
entries.definitionCN: 用发酵大豆制成的咸味深色酱汁，与 soybean 共享 soy 这一成分

entries.definition: a milky drink made from ground soybeans
entries.definitionCN: 用大豆磨制而成的植物奶饮品，原料即 soybean

entries.definition: a soft white food made from curdled soy milk
entries.definitionCN: 由豆浆凝固而成的白色软质食品，是大豆的主要制品

entries.definition: young green soybeans eaten boiled from the pod
entries.definitionCN: 尚未成熟、连荚煮食的青绿色大豆

normalIntro.en: Soybean is a plain compound: an old trade word for soy joined to the everyday word bean.
normalIntro.cn: soybean 是个朴实的复合词：表示「酱油、大豆」的老词 soy 加上日常的 bean。

normal.en: The plant arrived under the name soy, then English added bean to name the seed.
normal.cn: 这种植物先以 soy 之名传入，英语再补上 bean，指明它是豆荚里的豆子。

normal.en: The spellings S-O-Y and S-O-Y-A both survive, as in soy sauce and soya milk.
normal.cn: soy 与 soya 两种拼写都保留至今，见于 soy sauce 与 soya milk。

normal.en: The hyphen has dropped out, leaving the single word S-O-Y-B-E-A-N.
normal.cn: 连字符逐渐被省去，最终合成一个词 soybean。

normal.en: Compare soybean with soybean meal and soybean oil, where the seed names a product.
normal.cn: 对比 soybean meal 与 soybean oil，这时豆子已经成为产品名称。

normal.en: Soybean belongs with legume crops such as pea and lentil, all named for the pod.
normal.cn: soybean 与 pea、lentil 同属豆类作物，名称都围绕豆荚展开。

abstract.en: Picture a muddy field where the rows all end in fat pods.
abstract.cn: 想象一片湿润的田地，田垄尽头全是饱满的豆荚。

abstract.en: See a mill crushing seeds into a golden stream of oil.
abstract.cn: 想象一座磨坊把豆子压碎，淌出金色的油。

abstract.en: Imagine a ship loading sacks of this crop at a busy port.
abstract.cn: 想象一艘船在繁忙的港口装载一袋袋这种作物。

examples.en: Farmers in the region rotate corn with soybean to keep the soil healthy.
examples.cn: 该地区的农民让玉米与大豆轮作，以保持土壤肥沃。

examples.en: Soybean meal is a protein-rich feed for pigs and poultry.
examples.cn: 豆粕是富含蛋白质的猪禽饲料。

examples.en: The label lists soybean among the allergens.
examples.cn: 标签把大豆列在过敏原一栏中。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「梭衣豆」——想象穿着蓑衣的农人在田里摘豆子；这只是谐音联想，与真实词源无关。

root: 日语 shoyu（酱油）→ 荷兰语 soja → 英语 soy（酱油；大豆）+ bean（豆子）→ soybean（大豆），核心义「来自东方的豆」。

sensesIntro.en: Soybean starts as the plant and its seed, then extends to the food and oil it yields, to a traded crop, to feed, and to modern research and politics.
sensesIntro.cn: soybean 先指这种作物及其种子，再延伸到它带来的食物和油、大宗贸易作物、饲料，以及现代科研与贸易话题。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a split pod holding three round yellow seeds.
core.cn: 核心意象：裂开的豆荚里躺着几颗圆圆的黄色豆子。

branches.en: The plant and the seed are the base sense.
branches.cn: 作物与种子构成基础义项。

branches.en: Food and oil are what the seed yields.
branches.cn: 食物与油是豆子榨出的产物。

branches.en: The bulk crop sense grows from farm trade.
branches.cn: 大宗作物的义项从农业贸易中生长出来。

branches.en: Oil for people and meal for animals both come from the same seed.
branches.cn: 供人食用的油与供畜食用的豆粕来自同一颗豆子。

branches.en: Modern farming, genetics, and tariffs all make news about this crop.
branches.cn: 现代农业、遗传学与关税让这种作物频上新闻。

intro.en: Soybean is a compound of an adopted trade word and a native English noun, with no Latin prefix or suffix.
intro.cn: soybean 由外来贸易词与英语本族名词合成，不含拉丁语前缀或后缀。

latinIntro.en: No Latin element builds this word; soy and soya were borrowed through European trade languages.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有拉丁语构词成分；soy 与 soya 是经由欧洲贸易语言借入的。

items.example: Soy is the first element of the compound.
items.exampleCN: soy 是复合词的前一部分。

items.example: Soya is the longer variant used in Britain.
items.exampleCN: soya 是英国更常用的较长变体。

items.example: Bean names the podded seed.
items.exampleCN: bean 指明带荚的种子。

items.example: Soybean is written as one word today.
items.exampleCN: 如今 soybean 写作一个词。

items.example: The plural adds -s.
items.exampleCN: 复数形式在词尾加 -s。

items.example: Soy milk keeps the borrowed short form.
items.exampleCN: soy milk 保留了借入的短形式。

items.example: Soy sauce names the original product.
items.exampleCN: soy sauce 指最初的那种产品。

items.example: Soybean meal names the feed product.
items.exampleCN: soybean meal 指饲料产品。

items.example: Soybean oil keeps the material sense.
items.exampleCN: soybean oil 保留原料含义。

definition_en: a vehicle designed to travel in outer space, usually carrying people or cargo
core_image: 一艘银色的飞船点火升空，尾焰在夜空里划出一道长长的光
scene: 发射场上，人群仰头望着白色的箭体缓缓离开地面。The spaceship lifted off at dawn and soon vanished into the clouds.
sceneCN: 这里 spaceship 是「宇宙飞船」（第 1 个义项：能在太空中航行的飞行器）；句意：飞船在黎明时点火升空，很快就消失在云层里。

derivatives.zh: 由 space 与 craft（飞行器）构成的同义近义词，比 spaceship 更正式
spaceship 作定语与名词搭配，指飞船设计
由 space 与 port（港口）构成，指飞船起降的航天港，与 spaceship 同属 space 词族

senses.title: A vehicle for outer space
senses.definition: a vehicle built to travel outside the earth and its atmosphere
senses.definitionCN: 在地球及其大气层之外航行的交通工具
senses.example: The spaceship carried three astronauts to the station.
senses.exampleCN: 这艘飞船把三名宇航员送到了空间站。
senses.why: Space means the vast area beyond the earth and ship means a vessel that carries people, so the compound names a vessel for space.
senses.whyCN: space 指地球之外的广阔空间，ship 指载人的船只，二者相加就是「在太空里装载人的船」。

senses.title: A fictional craft in stories
senses.definition: an imaginary craft that travels between stars in stories and films
senses.definitionCN: 故事与电影中来往于星球之间的想象交通工具
senses.example: The film shows a huge spaceship circling the planet.
senses.exampleCN: 电影里一艘巨大的飞船环绕着行星飞行。
senses.why: Science fiction gave the word its most colourful life, so it also means the imagined craft of popular storytelling.
senses.whyCN: 科幻小说让这个词广为流传，所以它也指通俗故事里想象出来的飞船。

senses.title: A vehicle for cargo or supplies
senses.definition: an unmanned vessel that carries supplies and equipment to orbit
senses.definitionCN: 向轨道运送补给与设备的无人飞行器
senses.example: A robot spaceship delivered fuel to the crew.
senses.exampleCN: 一艘货运飞船给乘组送去了燃料。
senses.why: Ships on earth carry goods, and the space version took over that duty for stations in orbit.
senses.whyCN: 地球上的船运送货物，太空版也承担了为轨道空间站运送物资的任务。

senses.title: A vehicle returning to the ground
senses.definition: a crewed craft designed to come back and land safely
senses.definitionCN: 设计用于返回并安全着陆的载人飞行器
senses.example: The spaceship landed softly in a desert clearing.
senses.exampleCN: 飞船在沙漠空地上平稳着陆。
senses.why: The sea going sense of a returning vessel extended naturally to the risky landing of a space craft.
senses.whyCN: 船只出海后总要归港，这一层含义自然延伸到飞船返回着陆的风险之上。

senses.title: A figurative vehicle
senses.definition: something described as carrying people through a strange or vast world
senses.definitionCN: 被用来比喻运送人们穿越陌生或广阔世界的载体
senses.example: Some writers call the internet a spaceship of ideas.
senses.exampleCN: 有些作家把互联网称为思想的宇宙飞船。
senses.why: Because the craft carries people into the unknown, writers use it for anything that does the same.
senses.whyCN: 因为飞船载人进入未知，作家便用它比喻任何能带人进入新世界的事物。

senses.title: A reusable craft
senses.definition: a craft that can fly again after returning, cutting the cost of each trip
senses.definitionCN: 返回后可以再次飞行、降低单次成本的飞行器
senses.example: The company plans to reuse every spaceship on more than one trip.
senses.exampleCN: 这家公司计划让每艘飞船都执行不止一次任务。
senses.why: Ships at sea sail many times, so the idea of a reusable hull moved into modern space travel.
senses.whyCN: 海上的船总是一再出航，这个「重复使用」的想法也随之进入现代航天。

senses.title: A toy or model craft
senses.definition: a small plastic or paper model shaped like a space craft, used in play or display
senses.definitionCN: 做成飞行器形状的塑料或纸制小模型，用于玩耍或陈设
senses.example: The child held a tiny spaceship in each hand.
senses.exampleCN: 孩子一手拿着一只小飞船玩具。
senses.why: Once a word is famous, its shape can be given to any small copy of the original object.
senses.whyCN: 一个词一旦广为人知，它的形状就会被赋予任何仿制品，于是出现「玩具飞船」的意思。

intro.en: Spaceship is a native English compound of space and ship, modelled on earlier words for sea and air vessels.
intro.cn: spaceship 是英语自造的复合词，由 space 与 ship 组成，仿照海上与空中运载工具的命名方式。

items.en: Latin spatium means an open area or extent, the ancestor of space.
items.cn: 拉丁语 spatium 意为开阔的场地或范围，是 space 的祖先。

items.en: English scap and scip have a common Germanic root and the word scipe, from Old English scyppan, means to create, not to sail.
items.cn: 英语的 -ship 后缀来自古英语 sceppan（创造），与表示船的古英语 scip 并不同源。

items.en: Space first means a period of time or a stretch of ground.
items.cn: 十四世纪时 space 先指一段时间或一段空地。

items.en: Space is used for the region beyond the earth in scientific prose.
items.cn: 十七世纪中叶，space 开始用于指地球之外的区域。

items.en: Writers such as MacColl, in his satires of eighteen eighty, use spaceship for a craft imagined in stories.
items.cn: 一般认为十九世纪末的讽刺作品里已用 spaceship 指故事中想象的飞行器。

items.en: Rocket age and science fiction popularise spaceship alongside spacecraft.
items.cn: 火箭时代与科幻作品让 spaceship 与 spacecraft 一同流行。

note.en: Spaceship belongs to the ship family of words and sits beside spacecraft, rocket, and shuttle.
note.cn: spaceship 属于 ship 这一词族，与 spacecraft、rocket、shuttle 处在同一义场。

entries.definition: a vehicle or craft that travels in space
entries.definitionCN: 在太空航行的飞行器，与 spaceship 构词相近、含义几乎相同，但更正式

entries.definition: the main ship in a fleet, or the best product of a company
entries.definitionCN: 舰队的旗舰，或公司的拳头产品；与 spaceship 共有 ship 这一成分

entries.definition: a large ship armed for fighting at sea
entries.definitionCN: 装备武器、用于海战的舰船，与 spaceship 共有 ship 这一成分

entries.definition: a vehicle driven by burning fuel that can leave the ground
entries.definitionCN: 靠燃料燃烧推进、能够离开地面的飞行器

entries.definition: a craft that makes repeated trips between earth and orbit
entries.definitionCN: 在地球与轨道之间往返的航天飞机

entries.definition: an object that moves around a planet, such as a station or probe
entries.definitionCN: 环绕行星运行的物体，如空间站或探测器

normalIntro.en: Spaceship is a plain compound: space plus ship, a ship that sails through space.
normalIntro.cn: spaceship 是直白的复合词：space 加 ship，即在太空里航行的船。

normal.en: Ship has sailed the seas for over a thousand years, so spaceship reuses a familiar hull.
normal.cn: ship 在海上航行了千百年，所以 spaceship 沿用了一个熟悉的船壳。

normal.en: The pair spacecraft and spaceship is like pair of shoes: one formal, one casual.
normal.cn: spacecraft 与 spaceship 就像一双鞋：一只正式，一只口语。

normal.en: The same ship element appears in warship, airship, and flagship.
normal.cn: 同一个 ship 成分也出现在 warship、airship 与 flagship 中。

normal.en: Say the word slowly: SPEIS-shihp, with the stress on the first part.
normal.cn: 慢读这个词：重音落在前半段 space 上。

normal.en: Compare spacesuit: the suit dresses the body, the ship carries it.
normal.cn: 对比 spacesuit：suit 包裹身体，ship 运载身体。

abstract.en: Imagine a canoe with rocket fins, sliding up into the dark.
abstract.cn: 想象一只长了火箭尾鳍的独木舟，滑向黑暗的天空。

abstract.en: Picture a tiny capsule falling back into the sea with parachutes.
abstract.cn: 想象一个小舱在降落伞的牵引下落回大海。

abstract.en: See a toy rack with rows of model ships on a child shelf.
abstract.cn: 想象一层层架子上摆满模型船的玩具架。

examples.en: Engineers tested a new spaceship for months before its first flight.
examples.cn: 工程师们对一艘新飞船测试了好几个月，才让它首次飞行。

examples.en: The spaceship docked with the station after two days in orbit.
examples.cn: 飞船在轨道上飞行两天后与空间站对接。

examples.en: In the cartoon, a crew of robots runs a broken old spaceship.
examples.cn: 在这部动画里，一伙机器人开着一艘破旧的飞船。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「死背时」——考试时死记硬背，脑子里飞起一艘飞船；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 spatium（开阔空间）→ 古法语 espace → 英语 space（空间）；+ 古英语 scip（船）→ ship → 合成 spaceship（太空之船），核心义「航行于太空的船」。

sensesIntro.en: Spaceship begins as any craft that travels beyond the earth, then covers imagined craft, cargo craft, returning craft, reusable craft, and small models.
sensesIntro.cn: spaceship 先指任何飞离地球的飞行器，再扩展到想象中的飞船、货运飞船、返航飞船、可复用飞船以及小小的模型。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a silver vessel lifting off with a bright tail of fire.
core.cn: 核心意象：银色船体点火升空，拖出明亮的火尾。

branches.en: A craft beyond the atmosphere is the base sense.
branches.cn: 大气层之外的飞行器是基础义项。

branches.en: The imagined craft lives in stories and films.
branches.cn: 想象出来的飞船生活在故事与电影里。

branches.en: Cargo craft carry rather than carry people.
branches.cn: 货运飞船只运货而不载人。

branches.en: Every craft that goes up must come back and land.
branches.cn: 凡是升空的飞船都必须返回并着陆。

branches.en: The word also names metaphors and toys that borrow its shape.
branches.cn: 这个词还用来比喻，并指借其外形制成的小玩具。

intro.en: Spaceship is a two part English compound; space describes the place and ship names the vehicle.
intro.cn: spaceship 是两段式英语复合词：space 说明场所，ship 标明载具。

latinIntro.en: Only space traces back to Latin spatium; ship is Germanic and unrelated to the -ship suffix in friendship.
latinIntro.cn: 只有 space 可追溯到拉丁语 spatium；ship 属于日耳曼语，与 friendship 中的 -ship 后缀无关。

items.example: Space supplies the setting of the compound.
items.exampleCN: space 提供复合词的场景。

items.example: Ship names the vehicle.
items.exampleCN: ship 标明载具。

items.meaning: a craft for travel in space
items.example: Spaceship merges the two parts.
items.exampleCN: spaceship 把两部分合为一体。

items.example: The plural adds -s.
items.exampleCN: 复数形式在词尾加 -s。

items.meaning: a formal word for the vehicle
items.example: Spacecraft is the formal partner.
items.exampleCN: spacecraft 是它的正式同义词。

items.meaning: a sealed suit for wearing in space
items.example: Spacesuit shares the space element.
items.exampleCN: spacesuit 共享 space 成分。

items.meaning: the planning of such a craft
items.example: The noun can act as a modifier.
items.exampleCN: 这个词作定语时可以修饰名词。

items.example: Warship shares the ship element.
items.exampleCN: warship 共享 ship 成分。

items.example: Airship shows another place plus ship pattern.
items.exampleCN: airship 展示了另一种「场所加船」的形式。

definition_en: having plenty of room, so that people and things fit easily
core_image: 推开门，一个又高又宽的房间，家具之间还有大片空着的地板
scene: 老宅的客厅高顶落地窗，家具之间留出大片空地，人走进去脚步都会放轻。The spacious hall echoed as she crossed it.
sceneCN: 这里 spacious 是「宽敞的」（第 1 个义项：空间足够大、有大量余地的）；句意：她穿过宽敞的大厅时，脚步声在里面回荡。

derivatives.zh: space 加 -ous 成 spacious，再加 -ly 构成副词，义为「宽敞地」
spacious 加 -ness 构成名词，义为「宽敞程度」
spacious 的词根名词，义为「空间；腾出间距」

senses.title: Having plenty of room
senses.definition: large enough inside to hold people or furniture without crowding
senses.definitionCN: 内部空间足够大，能容纳人或家具而不显拥挤
senses.example: They moved into a spacious flat near the park.
senses.exampleCN: 他们搬进了公园附近一套宽敞的公寓。
senses.why: The adjective is built on space plus the suffix meaning full of, so it describes a place that is full of room.
senses.whyCN: 这个形容词由 space 加上表示「充满」的后缀构成，描写一个充满余地的场所。

senses.title: Open and wide outdoors
senses.definition: covering a wide open area, as of land, fields, or sky
senses.definitionCN: 覆盖大片开阔区域，如土地、田野或天空
senses.example: The spacious plains stretched far beyond the road.
senses.exampleCN: 开阔的平原一直延伸到公路之外很远。
senses.why: The same roomy quality applies to open land, so the word also describes wide outdoor scenes.
senses.whyCN: 同样的「宽阔有余」也适用于露天土地，所以这个词也形容开阔的户外景象。

senses.title: Generous and ample
senses.definition: larger than expected, giving a feeling of generous allowance
senses.definitionCN: 比预期更大，给人一种宽绰、大方的感觉
senses.example: The house has spacious windows that let in lots of light.
senses.exampleCN: 这房子的窗户宽大，让大量光线照进来。
senses.why: Space can mean a generous allowance, so the adjective lends itself to anything more ample than usual.
senses.whyCN: space 也可指宽裕的额度，于是这个形容词可以形容任何比常规更充裕的事物。

senses.title: Room-like in a text
senses.definition: set out with wide margins and open spacing rather than tight lines
senses.definitionCN: 留有宽阔页边、行距疏朗，而不是排得很紧
senses.example: The report uses a spacious page layout.
senses.exampleCN: 这份报告采用了疏朗的页面版式。
senses.why: Printed space is still space, so the word describes layouts that keep plenty of white area.
senses.whyCN: 印刷中的留白同样是空间，所以这个词也形容保留大片空白的版式。

senses.title: Expansive in manner
senses.definition: giving or receiving in a large and open way, said of manner or spirit
senses.definitionCN: 以大方、开放的方式给予或接纳，形容举止或胸怀
senses.example: His spacious welcome made every guest feel at ease.
senses.exampleCN: 他宽阔的迎接方式让每位客人都感到自在。
senses.why: Room to breathe became a metaphor for an open, generous personality.
senses.whyCN: 「有地方容身」被引申为形容人胸怀开阔、待人大方。

senses.title: Room to move
senses.definition: giving people freedom to move about or work without being blocked
senses.definitionCN: 让人可以自由走动或工作而不受阻碍
senses.example: The new studio is spacious enough for three people to work side by side.
senses.exampleCN: 这间新工作室宽敞得足够三个人并排工作。
senses.why: Because the core sense is room to spare, the word naturally names freedom of movement.
senses.whyCN: 由于核心含义是「有多余的余地」，这个词也自然用来表示行动自由。

intro.en: Spacious comes from Latin spatium, open space, through the adjective spatiosus and the French form spacieux.
intro.cn: spacious 来自拉丁语 spatium（开阔空间），经由形容词 spatiosus 与法语 spacieux 传入英语。

items.en: Spatium means an open area, a stretch of time, or a distance.
items.cn: spatium 意为开阔场地、一段时间或一段距离。

items.en: Spatiosus means roomy or of wide extent.
items.cn: spatiosus 意为宽敞的、范围广大的。

items.en: Spacieux carries the adjective into French.
items.cn: spacieux 把这个形容词带入法语。

items.en: Spacious appears in Middle English spelling as spacious or spacius.
items.cn: spacious 在中古英语中已出现，拼写略有浮动。

items.en: Spacious settles into describing rooms, land, and later layouts and personalities.
items.cn: 现代英语中 spacious 稳定用于形容房间、土地，后来又用于版式与性格。

note.en: Spacious sits in the space family, next to spaciousness, spaciously, and near the wider sense of roomy.
note.cn: spacious 属于 space 词族，与 spaciousness、spaciously 同族，也与 roomy 等近义词相邻。

entries.definition: an area that is empty and available
entries.definitionCN: 空着、可用的区域，是 spacious 的词根名词

entries.definition: the quality of being roomy
entries.definitionCN: 由 spacious 加 -ness 构成，指宽敞的程度

entries.definition: seeming right but actually false
entries.definitionCN: 看似正确实则虚假的；与 spacious 只是拼写相近，词源不同

entries.definition: having plenty of room inside
entries.definitionCN: 内部空间充足的，比 spacious 更口语

entries.definition: measuring a large distance from side to side
entries.definitionCN: 两边的距离很大的，强调横向尺寸

entries.definition: extremely large in area or amount
entries.definitionCN: 面积或数量极大的，程度远超 spacious

normalIntro.en: Spacious is Latin space plus the suffix that means full of, so it means full of room.
normalIntro.cn: spacious 是 space 加上表示「富有、充满」的后缀，等于「充满空间」。

normal.en: The suffix -ous often marks full of something, as in famous and dangerous.
normal.cn: 后缀 -ous 常表示「充满某物」，如 famous 与 dangerous。

normal.en: Strip the -ous and the root space shows through clearly.
normal.cn: 去掉 -ous，词根 space 就清楚地露出来了。

normal.en: The adverb spaciously and the noun spaciousness keep the same core.
normal.cn: 副词 spaciously 与名词 spaciousness 保持同一个核心。

normal.en: Compare spacious with spatial: the first is wide, the second is about position.
normal.cn: 对比 spacious 与 spatial：前者强调大而宽，后者指与位置有关。

normal.en: The phrase light and spacious is a fixed pair in estate agents.
normal.cn: light and spacious 是房产中介常用的固定搭配。

abstract.en: Picture a tall window casting a long square of light on the floor.
abstract.cn: 想象一扇高窗在地板上投下一块长长的方块光。

abstract.en: Imagine a hall so long that footsteps bounce back twice.
abstract.cn: 想象一条长到脚步声会反弹两次的大厅。

abstract.en: See wide margins around a page of text, like white fields.
abstract.cn: 想象一页文字四周宽阔的页边，就像白色的田野。

examples.en: The kitchen is bright and spacious, with a table for six.
examples.cn: 这间厨房明亮宽敞，还放得下一张六人桌。

examples.en: A spacious garden gives children room to run.
examples.cn: 开阔的花园让孩子们有地方奔跑。

examples.en: The office feels more spacious after the old desks were removed.
examples.cn: 搬走旧办公桌之后，这间办公室显得更宽敞了。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「四倍一时」——把空间扩成四倍，一时就显得宽敞了；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 spatium（开阔空间）→ spatiosus（宽敞的）→ 法语 spacieux → 英语 spacious，核心义「充满余地」。

sensesIntro.en: Spacious starts from the roomy feeling inside a place, then extends to open land, ample allowance, loose layout, generous manner, and freedom to move.
sensesIntro.cn: spacious 先从屋内宽敞的感觉出发，再延伸到开阔的土地、宽绰的额度、疏朗的版式、大方的心境以及自由活动的余地。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a door opening on a tall, wide room with empty floor.
core.cn: 核心意象：推开门，高而宽的房间，地板空着一大片。

branches.en: A roomy interior is the everyday sense.
branches.cn: 宽敞的室内是日常义项。

branches.en: Open land and sky are the outdoor sense.
branches.cn: 开阔的田野与天空是户外义项。

branches.en: Anything more ample than usual takes the word.
branches.cn: 任何比常规更充裕的事物都可以用它。

branches.en: Printed space and generous manners both borrow the idea of room.
branches.cn: 印刷留白与大方举止都借用了「余地」这一意象。

branches.en: A spacious place gives people freedom to move.
branches.cn: 宽敞的场所给人自由活动的余地。

intro.en: Spacious is built from the Latin stem spac-, the suffix -ous, and later English suffixes -ly and -ness.
intro.cn: spacious 由拉丁词干 spac-、后缀 -ous 构成，后来又加上英语后缀 -ly 与 -ness。

latinIntro.en: Latin spatium gives both the noun space and the adjective spacious; spatiosus and spacieux are the linking forms.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 spatium 同时生出名词 space 与形容词 spacious，中间形态是 spatiosus 与法语 spacieux。

items.example: Spatium is the ultimate root.
items.exampleCN: spatium 是最终词根。

items.example: The suffix -ous turns space into an adjective.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -ous 把 space 变成形容词。

items.example: Spacious keeps the full of room sense.
items.exampleCN: spacious 保留「充满余地」之义。

items.example: The suffix -ly forms spaciously.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -ly 构成 spaciously。

items.example: The suffix -ness forms the noun of quality.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -ness 构成表示性质的名词。

items.example: Space is the base noun.
items.exampleCN: space 是基础名词。

items.example: Spatial shares the same stem.
items.exampleCN: spatial 共享同一词干。

items.example: Specious looks close but is not related.
items.exampleCN: specious 看着相似，其实无关。

items.example: Roomy is the everyday partner.
items.exampleCN: roomy 是更口语的同义词。

definition_zh: 稀疏的；稀少的；零星分布的；内容贫乏的；（人口或植被）覆盖密度低
definition_en: thinly spread out, with wide gaps between the items or people in a place, group or set
core_image: 一片干草地上只有几株小草，中间隔着大片空地
scene: 旱季的草原黄褐发干，放眼望去只有几丛枯草。In the dry season, the sparse grass on the plain could not hide a single stone.
sceneCN: 这里 sparse 是「稀疏的」（第 1 个义项：东西少而彼此间隔很大）；句意为旱季平原上稀疏的草连一块石头都遮不住；画面里有枯草、平原与午后热光。

pos.zh: 形容词：稀疏的；稀少的；零星的

derivatives.zh: 由 sparse 加 -ly 构成，义为「稀疏地」
由 sparse 加 -ness 构成，义为「稀疏；稀少」
由拉丁语 sparsio（散布）一类词尾演变而来，多见于统计与计算领域，义为「稀疏性」

senses.title: Thinly spread with wide gaps
senses.definition: present in small numbers and spread far apart, leaving large empty spaces between
senses.definitionCN: 数量少且彼此离得很远，中间空出大片地方
senses.example: Only a few sparse bushes grew on the dry hillside.
senses.exampleCN: 干燥的山坡上只长着几丛稀疏的灌木。
senses.why: The core picture of things scattered thinly on a surface becomes the everyday adjective for anything with big gaps between items.
senses.whyCN: 核心画面是稀稀落落地散布在表面上，因此它天然指任何「间隔大、数量少」的东西。

senses.title: Low in number or density
senses.definition: used of population, cover or presence that is low in relation to the area it occupies
senses.definitionCN: 用于人口、覆盖或出现程度相对于所占面积偏低的情形
senses.example: The far north is a sparse region with very few towns.
senses.exampleCN: 最北部是人口稀疏的地区，城镇极少。
senses.why: Once people or plants are the scattered items, the same picture turns into a statement about density over an area.
senses.whyCN: 当被散布的对象变成人或植物时，同一个画面就变成了关于单位面积密度的判断。

senses.title: Scattered here and there
senses.definition: appearing at irregular and wide intervals rather than in a continuous pattern
senses.definitionCN: 以不规则、间距很大的方式出现，而非连续成片
senses.example: Sparse raindrops began to hit the dusty road.
senses.exampleCN: 零星的雨点开始落在满是尘土的路上。
senses.why: The gaps matter as much as the items, so the word naturally describes occurrences that are interrupted by long pauses.
senses.whyCN: 空隙和物件同样重要，这个词因此自然描写「时不时才出现一下」的现象。

senses.title: Thin or scanty in texture
senses.definition: growing thinly so that the underlying surface shows through
senses.definitionCN: 生长得稀薄，能透出下面的表面
senses.example: He combed his sparse grey hair back with some care.
senses.exampleCN: 他仔细地把稀疏的灰白头发往后梳。
senses.why: Physically spread-out strands let the skin or soil show, an image faithful to the sense of being scattered.
senses.whyCN: 一根根散开的发丝让头皮或土壤露出来，正是「散开」这一意象的实物版。

senses.title: Thin in content
senses.definition: containing only a little information or detail, especially when more was expected
senses.definitionCN: 只含少量信息或细节，尤其在本来期望更多的场合
senses.example: The data were too sparse to support a firm conclusion.
senses.exampleCN: 数据太稀少，无法支持确切的结论。
senses.why: Information can be scattered like seeds, so a few isolated data points make an account feel thin and unsubstantial.
senses.whyCN: 信息也能像种子一样零散播撒，几个孤立的数据点便让描述显得单薄。

intro.en: Sparse comes from Latin sparsus, the past participle of spargere, to scatter or strew.
intro.cn: sparse 来自拉丁语 sparsus，是动词 spargere（撒、散播）的过去分词。

items.en: The root behind spargere may be the reconstructed form *sperg-, to strew.
items.cn: spargere 背后的词根一般认为是重构形式 *sperg-，意为撒、铺开。

items.en: Spargere means to scatter or sprinkle, and sparsus is its past participle.
items.cn: spargere 意为撒开、散布，sparsus 是其过去分词。

items.en: Sparse itself appears in medieval Latin as sparsus, strewn, used of things thinly spread.
items.cn: sparse 这一拼写见于中世纪拉丁语 sparsus，本义「被撒开的」，用于形容稀稀落落地分布。

items.en: English borrows sparse through Latin writings and applies it first to vegetation and texture.
items.cn: 英语经拉丁文书转借入 sparse，最初多用于植被与质地。

items.en: Its use widens to population, data and other abstract sets.
items.cn: 其用法扩展到人口、数据等抽象集合。

note.en: Sparse belongs to the Latin scattering family with disperse and sparsity, and to a cluster of thinness words.
note.cn: sparse 属于拉丁语的「散开」词族，与 disperse、sparsity 同源，并与一批表示「稀薄」的词相邻。
